The '''''Radiant Splendor''''' was a [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[Barzo cargo freighter]]<ref name="Cat and Mouse" /> that was flown during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Shortly after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|171|Jokot}}</ref> the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was hauling a cargo of textiles, [[Holocube/Legends|holocubes]] and a [[Corellian sand panther/Legends|Corellian sand panther]] when the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] owner lost it to the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Kelna Toodo]] in a game of dice. Toodo owed a debt to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]]-owner [[Beeda]] and he considered selling the ship and its cargo to raise some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] to help pay off the Hutt, but he decided against that course of action because he was afraid of the panther and was concerned that he wouldn't be able to find a buyer for the creature on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. After Beeda tasked Toodo with eliminating a group of individuals who had meddled with the Hutt's affairs, Beeda utilized the freighter in his scheme, by having his [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] accomplice [[Lyt Re]] deliberately lose the vessel to his targets in [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game that was held in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[The White Door]], in the port town [[Akmalla]] on a world near [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The individuals departed in the freighter and Toodo pursued them in the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] ''[[Hot Streak]]'', planning to remotely de-activate the panther's cage, so that it could [[Death/Legends|kill]] the agents, then to scuttle the ''Radiant Splendor'' and conceal the evidence of his crime. However, the individuals succeeded at fending off the panther, and they prevented Toodo from eliminating them.<ref name="Cat and Mouse" />
